tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i gzungs la phul ba'i yi ge bzhugs// oṃ sarba bit+pu ra/ su ra su ra/ arbar+t+ta ya arbar+t+ta ya ho/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sa ra/ pra mar+dha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ ta ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re mahā badz+re/ mahā te dz+ro badz+re/ mahā bid+yā badz+re/ mahā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ tra ma ṇa badz+re/ sarba karma arba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā rā ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ sam+p+ra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ prā tsa li ni pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā da swā bhā we na badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni/ san+to kha ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba bi d+yā swāhā/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbh+ruṃ khāṃ badz+ri bhā wa tri dh+ra tiṣ+ṭha bu khaṃ swāhā/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wa he tun+te ṣan+ta thā ga te h+ye ba datra/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e waṃ ba dī mahā shra ma ṇa/ ngo mtshar mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'ongs 'dis/ /mtshon pa'i dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin gyis/ /srid mtha'i bar du khams gsum kun bkang te/ /bsod nams zhing gyur mchod yul thams cad mchod/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /ngag dbang kun bsod dpon slob gdul byar bcas/ /kun gyi sdig kun byang nas dus 'di la/ /tshe ring nad med bsam pa mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma lhan cig dag pa'i zhing bgrod nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /de nyid de bzhin nyid du nges gyur nas/ /de las gzhan du nam yang ma gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi yon bdag nged rang gi gzugs kyi nang du gong gi gzungs sngags rnams dang / gzhan yang stod gzungs bar gzungs pad gzungs rnams cha tshang ba/ a ma ra na brgya dang bcu gcig tshigs bcad la/ ngo mtshar mchod pa'i lha mo yid 'ong 'dis/

/zhes pa'i dod maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla 'dis/ /zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas mtshon pa'i man gong dang 'dra ba yod pa bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i gzungs la phul ba'i yi ge/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
